name: bsafe
description: bSafe — silent SOS emergency web app

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @bsafe/api" "npm run dev -w @bsafe/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bsafe/api && npm run build -w @bsafe/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @bsafe/api && npm run lint -w @bsafe/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bsafe/api && npm run typecheck -w @bsafe/web
